# Haider Khursheed - Full Reference & Knowledge Profile

## Biography
Haider Khursheed is an Indian tech entrepreneur, software builder, and founder operating with an intense bias toward rapid execution. He serves as the Co-founder & CEO of Lixta Network, leading the company's expansion into enterprise engineering and AI-first product development. 

Haider has been building on the internet since age 11, exploring robotics, recording video productions, and building early games. At age 16, while pursuing a diploma in computer engineering, he founded a game development studio that produced titles for global clients and was acquired by a game publisher in mid-2024. In August 2024, Haider co-founded Lixta Network alongside Abdullah Yasin Shaikh, growing it into one of India's fast-emerging creative and AI software studios. In 2025, he co-founded Komunity.dev, raising a pre-seed round at a ₹12.9M valuation before pivoting its learnings toward new high-conviction initiatives. Alongside Lixta Network, Haider leads Home for Builders (a startup school and builder ecosystem) and Aeomi (an AI research lab exploring persistent cognitive memory architectures).

## Ventures & Timeline
- **Home for Builders (2026 - Present)**: Founder. Execution-first ecosystem for developers, designers, hackers, and internet builders building real products.
- **Aeomi (2026 - Present)**: Founder & AI Researcher. Frontier AI research lab focusing on cognitive memory systems, agentic reasoning, and long-horizon intelligence.
- **Lixta Network (2024 - Present)**: Co-founder & CEO. Creative studio and venture foundry turning manual workflows into AI-first software and high-impact enterprise solutions.
- **Komunity (2025 - 2026)**: Co-founder & CEO. Onchain hiring platform where work serves as identity. Raised ₹12.9M pre-seed valuation.
- **Game Development Studio (2021 - 2024)**: Founder. Scaled game development with global clients, successfully acquired by a game publisher in 2024.

## Areas of Expertise
- AI & Agentic Systems Architecture
- Venture Building & Startup Strategy
- Full-stack Web & Mobile Product Engineering
- Memory Systems in Autonomous Agents
- Product Distribution & Growth for Builders
